title: The Typing Cure: Experiences with Large Language Model Chatbots for Mental Health Support

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of semi-structured interviews with 21 globally diverse individuals, examining their experiences and challenges when attempting to communicate distress and receive mental health support from LLM chatbots in non-English native languages.

Qualitative analysis of semi-structured interviews evaluating how the Western-centric design, values, and advice generated by LLM chatbots create disconnects or misalignments with the cultural contexts and norms of non-Western users seeking mental health support.
